_source: The chain facts, in one place. README.md's Live on Monad table is generated from this file by scripts/gen-readme.ts, and site/public/index.html is held against it by scripts/test/readme.test.ts, so the page and the README cannot drift apart. Every address here was read on chain before first publication (docs/SITE.md). The first receipt is held against vid/receipts/pass.json, the document the API actually serves.

api.terms: x402, 0.10 USDC per check, exact scheme

firstReceipt._timing: Read once from https://rpc.monad.xyz on 2026-09-29: the block of executionTx from its receipt, and the timestamp of both blocks. The page derives the gap from these four values (scripts/gen-site.ts) and scripts/test/readme.test.ts holds the sentence to them. Nobody types the delay.

prereg._dates: docs/PREREG.md states its own date on its second line (Registered: 2026-09-17); gen-site.ts reads it from the file. firstCommit is read from git (the root commit, author date) and held to git by scripts/test/readme.test.ts. publicPost is the first public timestamp of the sha256: nothing was published on 17 September.

failures._source: The figures on the page under "The failure it is built for". Each is quoted verbatim, from the article itself, in docs/SOURCES.md; scripts/test/readme.test.ts fails if a figure here is not in the quoted line there. scripts/gen-site.ts renders the paragraph from these values.
